name: Arizona Automotive Equipment
old_description: Arizona Automotive Equipment, commonly known in the area as Mohawk Automotive Lifts Southwest, has been serving the Southwest region of the United States since 2004. We are a family-run operation that maintains the highest quality and standards while giving you the personal touch that often gets lost in today’s day and age.
about:
Arizona Automotive Equipment, also known as Mohawk Automotive Lifts Southwest, has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 2004. The company was founded by Mike and Karen Green to provide annual lift safety inspections and detailed reports for OSHA compliance. In January 2021, ownership passed to Jason and Brandi Byers, a husband-and-wife team who continue the family-run legacy.

The business supplies heavy-duty automotive lifts and equipment for commercial shops and personal garages, carrying brands such as Mohawk Lifts, Hunter Engineering, Challenger Lifts, Tuxedo Lifts, and Samson. Its product range includes two-post, four-post, mobile column, scissor, and specialty lifts for vehicles from passenger cars to heavy-duty trucks. In addition to sales, the company provides ALI-certified lift inspections and in-house installation services performed by its own technicians.

Customers span automotive repair shops, commercial garages, fleet maintenance operations, and personal garage owners throughout the Southwest. The company's inspectors are qualified to examine any lift regardless of manufacturer, brand, or age, issuing serialized ALI inspection labels that serve as proof of compliance for code enforcement.

The Byerses emphasize a personal-touch approach, offering personalized service, a comprehensive catalog, and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Their ALI-certified inspectors and focus on OSHA compliance differentiate the business in a market where safety certification is often a minimum requirement.
